Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Mechanical Engineering BS at University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

What University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign asks of applicants to Mechanical Engineering BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign courses · Engineering field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test-optional — ACT/SAT optional for all first-year applicants, including international students
  • Not required for any major

Illinois admits directly into a college and major; both Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering are in The Grainger College of Engineering, which considers ACT/SAT math and science subscores if provided.

Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ · Illinois: First-Year Admission Policies
English language
  • First-year applicants who did not complete Grades 10–12 in an approved English-speaking country must submit TOEFL iBT, IELTS, Duolingo English Test, ACT or SAT scores; this cannot be waived
  • If you report ACT/SAT scores, TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo scores are strongly encouraged (not required)
  • Scores must be from tests taken within two years of the intended entry term

Illinois publishes minimum TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo scores only for transfer applicants; no minimum score is stated for first-year applicants, so none is shown.

Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: International Requirements · Illinois: General Admission Policies
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test is listed for this major; auditions/portfolios/interviews apply only to Fine and Applied Arts talent-based programs.

Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: First-Year Requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: required high-school courses — English 4 years; Math at least 3.5 years including trigonometry or higher for all Grainger College of Engineering majors (4 years recommended); Social Science 2 years (4 recommended); Lab Sciences 2 years (4 recommended); Language other than English 2 years (4 recommended); Flexible academic units 2 years (4+ recommended). Grainger also focuses on proficiency in math and science.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: First-Year Requirements
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Applicants in the GCSE/GCE system self-report their GCSE/O-Level results and the A-Level subjects they plan to sit. Completion of A-Levels is required for first-year entry; AS Levels alone do not meet the first-year standard, and AS Level scores are not used in review.
Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: GCSE/GCE (O/A levels) – Application Help · Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
IB students self-report IB HL/SL course grades on the Self-Reported Academic Record. Illinois does not use the total diploma number or IB exam scores in review.
Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: International Baccalaureate – Application Help · Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ
Other qualifications
  • AP scores are not used in admission review
  • Taking an AP or IB course without the exam has no impact on the admission decision
Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ
Other requirements
  • 2–3 Illinois essays (about 150 words each, including first-choice-major essays) plus one Common App essay
  • Letters of recommendation are not accepted
  • This major is not available as a second-choice major
Verified19 Oct 2026Illinois: Essay Prompts · Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ · Illinois: First-Year Applicant FAQ
